name: Stammering
overview: Scripture acknowledges stammering as a real human limitation, exemplified by Moses who described himself as slow of speech and tongue when called by God (Exodus 4:10). Yet Isaiah reveals a hopeful transformation where even those with a stammering tongue will speak plainly and understand knowledge (Isaiah 32:4). Furthermore, Isaiah 33:19 contrasts the incomprehensible speech of a stammering tongue with the clarity God provides, emphasizing that stammering does not hinder God’s purpose or communication.
